notes: «وقال الليث عن أبي الأسود» names a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, never a route of the first
Ikrima is the link between Abu al-Aswad and Ibn Abbas: «ثم قال أخبرني ابن عباس» is his own report
«وغيره» is an unnamed co-transmitter, written as «غيره»

fixes.reason: HKG and K6I put محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن نوفل between Abu al-Aswad and Ikrima; the text writes no such link, only فلقيت عكرمة

evidence.quote: محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن نوفل
